messages:
maya: Quick check — preparing to put polaris-6b into the staging serving pool. I have weights at s3://rw-models/polaris/6b/v1/ (sha: a1b2c3). Two asks: (1) legal: any usage restrictions we need to flag in the model metadata? (2) infra: tokenizer has nonstandard BOS token id=0, could affect prefix caching. Please advise :eyes:
julie: Thanks — I looked at upstream. License appears to be Creative Commons NonCommercial (CC-BY-NC-4.0). We need an explicit 'non-commercial' flag and an attribution line. Also we should prevent Dedicated/reserved-serving until legal signs off. :thinking_face:
julie: snippet to include in model_card (paste):
```
model_card:
  license: "CC-BY-NC-4.0"
  attribution: "Original authors: PolarisAI"
  restrictions:
    - non_commercial: true
    - disallow_dedicated: true
```
kai: re: tokenizer — can you paste the tokenizer config path/contents? If BOS is 0 we either need to disable prefix_cache or add a tokenizer override in the runtime config (bos mapping).
maya: tokenizer config path: /models/polaris/6b/tokenizer.json
quick dump:```{"bos_token_id":0,"eos_token_id":2,"pad_token_id":1}```
aaron: ops note — weights currently live under s3://rw-models/polaris/6b/v1/ but that prefix is under a Glacier lifecycle rule. For serving we need either a copy to standard S3 or an expedited restore. I can copy to s3://rw-serving-cache/models/polaris/6b/v1 and set metadata. ETA tomorrow AM unless someone needs sooner.
maya: please copy and set metadata. Also we should add a routing rule: Hosted ingest can be allowed for dev/test but Hosted public API should be blocked for commercial tenants because of NC license. julie, can you confirm wording? :pray:
julie: confirm — add 'restricted_to_non_commercial: true' and policy 'disallow_dedicated: true' in model metadata. I'll open the compliance ticket with exact language.
legal-bot: Created ticket IN-2024: "polaris-6b: license flags + attribution" assigned to julie, priority P2.
kai: for serving config I propose adding overrides like:
```
runtime:
  tokenizer_overrides:
    bos_id: 0
  prefix_cache: false
  quant_profile: q4_0
```
also add attribution to /models/polaris/6b/model_card.md so console UI picks it up.
maya: will add a short model_card.md patch and a PR to infra config. @aaron can you ensure the S3 object gets x-amz-meta-license=cc-by-nc-4.0 so ingestion pipeline picks it up? e.g., `aws s3 cp --metadata "license=cc-by-nc-4.0,attribution=PolarisAI" ...`
aaron: Yep. I'll copy and set metadata. ETA: 10:30 PT tomorrow. I'll post the final s3 URL & acl after copy.
deploy-bot: Background job: build-serving-image for polaris-6b started (job 5482).
kai: once copy + metadata are done I can queue a canary deploy to staging. We should run a short eval focusing on NC-related content generation and attribution preservation — anyone want to add a prompt set?
maya: I'll add a small eval in /evals/polaris/6b/license-safe.json and reference it in the PR.
julie: Also add an explicit attribution line in the README as well as model_card; I can review the PR later today and suggest exact phrasing.
aaron: copy complete: s3://rw-serving-cache/models/polaris/6b/v1/sha=a1b2c3. Metadata: license=cc-by-nc-4.0, attribution=PolarisAI. Set ACL=private. Posted logs to ops channel. :white_check_mark:
maya: perfect — thanks everyone, moving this to the next step (PR + canary)
